pref.title: Preface
pref.para: This guide provides comprehensive coverage of DocBook 5.2 validation using the tiered validation approach. It covers all seven validation layers from basic well-formedness to advanced business rule validation.

listitem.para: Technical writers using DocBook 5.2 for documentation
Quality assurance teams implementing automated validation
